title: Tokenize Moments, Not Frames: Tokenizer-Aware Budget Allocation for Training-Free Video LLM Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2611.26933v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video large language models (LLMs) represent each video with thousands of visual tokens, and training-free accelerators that prune or merge these tokens lose accuracy on long videos. Analyzing frame similarity and the vision tokenizers of 16 open models, we trace this loss to a step before token selection. Under a token budget, the frames of a long video are sampled farther apart than the roughly 2 s over which frames remain similar. The two-frame 3D patches of models such as Qwen-VL then blend two unrelated scenes into each visual token, a double exposure that arises before any pruning or merging. Fixed-size tokenizers such as InternVL's avoid this blend but respond differently to the same reduction. We propose ESSENCE, a training-free method that tokenizes moments, segments within which frames remain similar, rather than frames. translated_title: 对时刻而非帧进行分词：面向免训练视频大语言模型加速的分词器感知预算分配
translated_abstract: 视频大语言模型（LLM）使用数千个视觉 token 来表示每段视频，而通过剪枝或合并这些 token 的免训练加速方法在长视频上会出现精度损失。通过分析 16 个开源模型的帧相似性与视觉分词器，我们将这种损失追溯到了 token 选择之前的一个环节。在 token 预算约束下，长视频的帧采样间隔超过了帧保持相似的约 2 秒时间窗口。诸如 Qwen-VL 这类采用双帧 3D patch 的模型会将两个不相关的场景混合进同一个视觉 token 中，形成一种“双重曝光”效应，而这在任何剪枝或合并操作发生之前就已产生。像 InternVL 这类固定尺寸的分词器虽然避免了这种混合，但在相同的压缩率下表现却不同。我们提出 ESSENCE，一种免训练方法，它对“时刻”（即帧保持相似的片段）而非帧进行分词。在编码之前，一个闭式规则利用采样间隔和分词器类别来设定时刻的数量。
tldr: 论文揭示了视频LLM加速中精度损失的根源在于token选择之前的分词阶段——长视频采样间隔超过约2秒相似窗口导致视觉token出现“双重曝光”混合，并提出免训练方法ESSENCE，通过对时刻而非帧进行分词、并依据采样间隔与分词器类别用闭式规则分配token预算，从而在不损失精度的情况下加速视频LLM。
en_tdlr: ESSENCE is a training-free video LLM acceleration method that traces accuracy loss to the tokenization stage—where sampling intervals exceeding the ~2s similarity window cause "double-exposure" blending of visual tokens—and instead tokenizes moments rather than frames, using a closed-form, tokenizer-aware rule to allocate the token budget.
